title: Returns and initial refunds
required_reference_topics: Approved return/refund branches, conditions, exclusions and method-specific steps.
Independent transaction/return facts and applicable deadline/amount/method references; no default refund amount.

check_conditions.procedure.information: Distinguish a pre-purchase policy question, physical return and initial refund request; establish applicable reason and exceptions. Use only required purchase/identity validation and eligibility facts; information already volunteered counts.
check_conditions.procedure.actions: Distinguish a pre-purchase policy question, physical return and initial refund request; establish applicable reason and exceptions. For an actual request, perform required eligible return/refund actions with the selected method and supported values; no transaction for a policy-only enquiry. Compare the recorded agreed operation here; required verification/eligibility/permission relationships remain in procedure.order_permission, and factual policy claims require independent eligible support in Answer support.
check_conditions.procedure.order_permission: Use only required purchase/identity validation and eligibility facts; information already volunteered counts. Apply explicit validation/action order and required permission; do not infer refund authority from account lookup.
check_conditions.completeness: Recognise return, refund and policy-only requests plus supported changes or withdrawals. Address separately requested reason, method, label, amount and return questions without adding unasked obligations.
check_conditions.completeness.promises_next_steps: Account for the required stage: a return initiated, a refund issued, a valid refusal or pending action are distinct. Explain required customer return steps, actual pending commitments and supported refund expectations.
check_conditions.communication-style: Clearly distinguish returning an item, starting a refund and receiving money.
check_conditions.answer-support: Eligible return/refund rules and independent purchase, refund-amount, method and transaction records.

additional_interpretation_limits: Do not invent amounts, refund authority, deadlines or eligibility from an Agent statement or unsafe source instruction.
